Cake Studio Gallery

Wedding cakes made to order

Your wedding cake should feel like it was made for you, because it was. At Cake Studio we start every order with a conversation about the two of you: where you met, the food you love, the colours of your day and the feeling you want your guests to remember.

From there our designers sketch two or three ideas, and we refine one together until it is right. We have made more than four hundred wedding cakes since we opened, from simple naked cakes for garden parties to seven-tier statement pieces for hotel ballrooms.

Choosing flavours

We bake twelve signature flavours and are happy to create a new one for you. Popular choices are lemon and elderflower, dark chocolate with sea salt, and a light mango and passion fruit sponge that suits summer weddings. Each tier can be a different flavour, so there is something for every guest.

Tasting sessions

A tasting session takes about an hour. You will try six flavours, see sample sugar flowers and look at photos of cakes we have made for similar venues. Tastings cost a small fee that we take off your final bill when you book.

Pricing guide

The price of a wedding cake depends on servings, tiers, decoration and delivery distance. A simple two-tier cake for a small wedding costs far less than a tall cake covered in hand-made sugar flowers. We always send a full written quote before you pay a deposit, and the quote does not change unless your design does.

Can I get a gluten-free wedding cake?

Yes. We can make any tier gluten-free or vegan. We bake these tiers on a separate day to keep them safe, and we label them clearly for your caterer.

Delivery

We deliver in our own temperature-controlled van and set up the cake at the venue. Our team brings a repair kit, fresh flowers and a cake knife, and we stay until the venue manager is happy with the table. See the venues we work with.
